name: Tong Tem Toh
tagline: The definitive northern Thai restaurant on Nimman
taglineZh: 宁曼路上的泰北菜殿堂
description: Tong Tem Toh is where locals and visitors go for authentic Lanna cuisine: khao soi, nam prik num with crudités, grilled pork neck and sai ua northern sausage. The sprawling garden compound on Nimman makes it perfect for groups.
descriptionZh: 通当陶是本地人和游客品尝地道兰纳菜的首选：咖喱面、青辣椒蘸酱配鲜蔬、炭烤猪颈肉与泰北香肠。宁曼路上偌大的庭院式餐厅非常适合聚餐。

location.address: 11 Nimmanhaemin Rd Soi 13, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai 50200

name: Khao Soi Khun Yai
tagline: The city's most revered khao soi, near Suan Dok
taglineZh: 松德寺旁最受推崇的清迈咖喱面
description: Run by the same family for decades, Khao Soi Khun Yai serves what many consider Chiang Mai's finest khao soi — rich coconut curry broth, tender chicken and perfectly crisp noodles. Arrive before noon; it sells out daily.
descriptionZh: 坤雅咖喱面由同一家族经营数十年，被公认为清迈最好吃的咖喱面——浓郁椰浆咖喱汤底、嫩滑鸡肉与恰到好处的酥脆面条。每天中午前售罄，宜早到。

location.address: Sri Phum Rd, Si Phum, Mueang Chiang Mai 50200

name: Dash! Restaurant & Bar
tagline: Teak-house dining in a fairy-lit garden
taglineZh: 柚木老宅配灯光花园的浪漫晚餐
description: Dash! serves refined northern and central Thai dishes in a magical lantern-lit garden around a century-old teak house near Tha Phae Gate. The grilled river fish, spring rolls and cocktails make it a favourite romantic dinner spot.
descriptionZh: Dash! 餐厅位于塔佩门附近一栋百年柚木老宅中，灯笼点点的花园氛围浪漫迷人。烤河鱼、泰式春卷与创意鸡尾酒使其成为最受欢迎的浪漫晚餐之选。

location.address: Moon Muang Rd Soi 7, Phra Sing, Mueang Chiang Mai 50200
